propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact) exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from writes on stdout, forcing agents to run secondary `rebar show` calls to verify mutations and causing spurious failure/retry cycles.

All in-scope verbs must print a single one-line kubectl-style confirmation to stdout on successful write (verb past-tense + args summary) and 'no change: <reason>' on idempotent no-op, both exiting 0 with no follow-up store read.
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) and silent reopen must normalize to the shared confirmation contract preserving all original datum.

Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted once at the router before partition dispatch to cover positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands), with --quiet suppressing text confirmations only and --output json nesting the outcome in a uniform mutation envelope.

The link verb's REDIRECT record (existing machine-readable JSON contract) must print byte-identical on write and no-op paths including under --quiet, with exactly one stdout result per invocation and no additional text confirmation line.

Consumed seam returns (e.g., add_dependency dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain type-identical and semantically unchanged; the CLI derives confirmations from existing seams or adds parallel outcome channels without altering consumed values.
